note: Sioux County Conservation area 4.5 mi north of Boyden on L-14: a wooded camping loop at the front of a 60-acre park with an 8-acre fishing pond (small-boat ramp) and a restored prairie. No firewood sold on site. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: 10 gravel water/electric sites (20/30/50-amp), $24, FCFS, modern restroom with showers, no dump. Season added (May 15-Sept 15). Waterfront 'not waterfront' confirmed: the 8-acre pond is about 45 m west behind dense woods.
flags: WATERFRONT OK (not waterfront): the pond is 8 acres ('an 8 acre pond'), so over the 5-acre line, but on Esri the loop sits about 45-60 m east of its shore with dense woods between, and no official photo shows the water from a site.
PHONE MISSING: 712-552-1047 (Sioux County Conservation, on the campground page: 'Call for Availability 712-552-1047').
FIT UNCLEAR, keep: 'gravel pads', no length posted; the loop is a small wooded one.
PIN OK: 43.25220,-96.00140 is on the loop beside the restroom.
